title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Atlanta
includes: A fun, hands-on 2-hour cooking class led by a talented local chef.
All ingredients and cooking tools provided.
Expert instruction, tips and chef secrets you’ll use daily.
An authentic experience hosted at a local public brewery, distillery, craft beer bar or wine bar.

policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: If chocolate is your love language, this class is calling your name. Led by Chef Amal, this interactive Atlanta cooking experience shows you how to make classic chocolate truffles from scratch with confidence. You’ll work with dark chocolate, cream and butter to create a velvety ganache, then shape and finish your truffles for a polished, professional look. Along the way, Chef Amal keeps things approachable, sharing techniques you can easily repeat in your own kitchen. The atmosphere is social, cozy and full of sweet rewards, making it an ideal choice for beginners, dessert lovers and anyone craving a deliciously memorable night out.
